### 🟢 Approval recommended It is a small, mechanical single-source-of-truth refactor whose every integration point (barrel/subpath exports, re-exports, readonly-type compatibility, and dist/tsc parity) was verified consistent and is covered by tests in all four affected packages. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR consolidates the quiet-hours notification bypass defaults (`DEFAULT_BYPASS_CATEGORIES`, currently `['permission', 'activity_error']`) into a single frozen, typed definition in `@chroxy/protocol`, eliminating three previously-duplicated hand-maintained copies in the server, dashboard, and app. It follows the repo's established single-source-of-truth pattern (like the notification category roster) and exposes the constant through a dependency-free package subpath so the server avoids loading the Zod schema bundle for this one constant. **Changes:** - Add `DEFAULT_BYPASS_CATEGORIES` to `packages/protocol/src/notification-categories.ts` (plus compiled `dist` artifacts) and a `./notification-categories` package subpath export. - Replace the three local definitions (server, dashboard, app) with re-exports of the shared constant, preserving each package's existing import surface and widening the editor prop types to `readonly string[]`. - Add cross-package tests asserting the server, dashboard, and app all resolve to the same frozen shared set, with explicit-override preservation. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `packages/​protocol/​src/​notification-categories.ts` | Defines the shared frozen `DEFAULT_BYPASS_CATEGORIES` with rationale doc comment. | | `packages/​protocol/​dist/​notification-categories.js` /​ `.d.ts` | Compiled artifacts matching the new source export (CI dist-drift gated). | | `packages/​protocol/​package.json` | Adds dependency-free `./notification-categories` subpath export. | | `packages/​protocol/​tests/​notification-categories.test.js` | New test: defaults immutable, duplicate-free, and within the roster. | | `packages/​server/​src/​notification-prefs.js` | Imports from the protocol subpath and re-exports; drops the local definition. | | `packages/​server/​tests/​notification-category-roster.test.js` | Asserts server export identity + daemon bypass decisions match the shared set. | | `packages/​dashboard/​src/​components/​SettingsPanel.tsx` | Imports shared constant; widens `bypassCategories` prop to `readonly string[]`. | | `packages/​dashboard/​src/​components/​SettingsPanel.test.tsx` | Asserts default checkboxes equal the shared set. | | `packages/​app/​src/​components/​settings/​constants.ts` | Re-exports the shared constant, preserving the settings import surface. | | `packages/​app/​src/​components/​settings/​QuietHoursEditor.tsx` | Widens `bypassCategories` prop to `readonly string[]`. | | `packages/​app/​src/​__tests__/​components/​SettingsScreenNotificationPrefs.test.ts` | Asserts the settings re-export is the shared frozen default. | | `packages/​app/​src/​__tests__/​components/​NotificationPrefsBypassDefaults.test.tsx` | New test: default render, explicit overrides, no mutation of the frozen default. | Verification notes: the root barrel re-exports via `export *` (both `src/index.ts` and compiled `dist/index.js`/`index.d.ts`), so dashboard/app imports from `@chroxy/protocol` resolve the new symbol without recompiling the barrel; the subpath dist is dependency-free (no imports); all consumer usages only read/spread the frozen array (compatible with `readonly string[]`); and the hand-edited dist matches tsc output (4-space indent, trailing comma, JSDoc) which the `check protocol dist is in sync` CI gate enforces.
Review effort: Balanced
